artworks.title: Henry IV
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man riding a horse, with both figures depicted in detail. The man is seated on the horse, holding a baton upright in his right hand. He wears a suit of armor and a cloak that billows behind him. The horse is adorned with a plumed headdress and a decorated cloth. In the background, there is a landscape with a river, buildings, and a crowd or army near the water's edge. Other figures and objects are also engraved in the scene, adding to the historical and military atmosphere. Text in French is present above the image.

artworks.title: Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in an upright position. He has a distinguished face with a beard and mustache, curly hair, and wears a symbol of authority. The man is dressed in a richly decorated robe with an elaborate collar and sleeves, held together by a star-shaped brooch. He holds a baton or scepter in his right hand. Elaborate architectural elements frame his figure, with pilasters on both sides and a curved top border. The background features hills and a small building in the distance. The artwork is rendered in black and white with detailed etching lines.

artworks.title: Henry IV of France
artworks.artist: Matthis Quad after Theodor de Bry
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the chest upwards. He has a long, narrow face, a pointed beard, slightly arched eyebrows, wavy hair, and is wearing a high-collared garment with an elaborate ruff around the neck. His clothing is richly decorated with embroidered patterns and a small crown and coat of arms appear next to him. The border is decorated with floral motifs and the background features closely lined shading. The top and bottom borders contain inscriptions with ornate lettering.

artworks.title: Henry IV, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a composed expression, elaborate hairstyle, short beard, and mustache. He wears ornate noble attire, including a high-collared ruff, richly decorated clothing, and a fur-lined cloak or robe. He also wears a chain of office with medallions and a large pendant. The background features a textured surface that does not distract from the man.

artworks.title: Henry IV
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the left. He has his right hand resting on a helmet with feathers and a crown. The man has an oval face, strong eyebrows, and a pointed mustache with a groomed beard. His hair is styled in waves and curls at the back of his neck. He wears an ornate hat with an upturned brim and a tall plume. The man is clothed in a detailed coat with buttons on the sleeves, a lace collar, and a patterned sash over his shoulder. In the background, there is an illustration of a crown above a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Henry IV
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to his left and looking directly at the viewer. The man has a beard and mustache, and curly hair under his crown. He is wearing a detailed outfit with an ornate collar, chain, pendant, and a circular medallion. The clothing is richly decorated with a pattern resembling ermine fur, and he wears a large crown with fleur-de-lis motifs. A medallion of the Order of the Holy Spirit is around his neck. The background features an oval frame with textured shading and engraved text encircling the portrait.

artworks.title: Henry IV, King of France
artworks.description: The image is a portrait that shows a person's upper body. The person faces the viewer with their head slightly turned to the right. They have a pointed beard and styled wavy hair. The person wears an elaborate garment with a high collar and a beaded sash. The garment has an ornate texture. Surrounding the person is an oval frame with inscriptions. The background features two male figures at the top and decorative elements on either side. The portrait is set against a background with engraved lines.

artworks.title: Henry IV, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an oval frame. He has a composed expression, a prominent beard and mustache, and curly hair. He wears an ornate garment with fur trim and a jeweled sash. The background is detailed with classical motifs and ornamental designs.

artworks.title: Henry IV of France
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a man's upper body, showcasing his face and chest. The man faces slightly to his left with a dignified posture. He has a prominent nose, high cheekbones, a full beard, and a mustache. His hair is thick and curly, styled backward. He wears a detailed garment with a high, ruffled collar and a decorative necklace. The background includes a patterned design and an ornate, oval frame with inscriptions around the man. The overall style conveys formality and nobility.

artworks.title: Murder of King Henry IV of France and the Execution of Francois Ravaillac
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting historical figures and events. The central part of the image features a grand carriage traveling through a city street, surrounded by smaller portraits and scenes. The composition is elaborate, with a circular design framing various components and figures in period attire. Surrounding the central scene are vignettes and framed portraits, each identified with inscriptions. The detailed line work suggests historical and architectural accuracy, seen in the costumes, carriages, and cityscapes. The drawing resembles etchings or prints from the early modern period and includes historical symbolism like banners, coats of arms, and text.

artworks.title: King Henry V
artworks.description: This engraving depicts a bust-length image of an individual in a regal pose, viewed from the side. The person is wearing a richly adorned crown and has a straight, prominent nose, with closely cropped hair, high cheekbones, and a defined chin. The facial expression is stern yet composed. The individual is dressed in a decorated robe with an intricate pattern and a fur-lined collar. Around the neck is a substantial, ornamental chain with medallions, and a decorative orb is held in one hand, while the other hand grasps a scepter. The background consists of an ornate frame with inscriptions. Regal symbols are seen around the frame, including shields and scrolls intertwined with decorative heraldry. The bottom of the image includes additional textual information about the depicted figure's reign and legacy.

artworks.title: Henry V of England
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in profile facing left. He has a stern expression, high forehead, straight nose, and short, neatly combed hair. The man wears a crown with intricate details, a heavily embroidered garment with a fur collar, and a chain around his neck. He holds a scepter in one hand and a small orb in the other. The background features an oval frame with text identifying him as "HENRICVS V. ANGLIAE ET FRANCIAE REX DOMINUS HIBERNIAE." Intricate scrollwork, a heraldic shield, and a written panel with historical information are also present. The paper shows signs of aging.

artworks.title: Henry VI of England
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, standing upright. He has a narrow face, thin lips, deeply set eyes, and short hair with a crown. He wears luxurious robes with fur and an elaborate necklace with a large medallion. In his left hand, he holds an orb, and in his right hand, a ceremonial staff. The background has ornate designs and Latin inscriptions, with symmetrical decorative elements.

artworks.title: Henry VI of England
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarters profile of a man identified as Henry VI of England, featuring his head and upper torso. He is seated, holding a scepter in his left hand and an orb in his right hand. He has particular facial features, including a prominent, angular jawline and thin lips, with deep-set eyes looking straight ahead. Henry VI wears a crown with jewels, and his short hair indicates thinning. He is dressed in an opulent robe with a fur collar, adorned with a necklace featuring large medallions and an intricately detailed brooch. The background features a circular engraved design with text around the perimeter, displaying patterns and symbols associated with royalty. The image includes detailed text providing historical information about Henry VI.

artworks.title: Henry VII
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body, turned slightly towards the viewer. His features include a nose, eyes, and mouth. He is wearing a hat with intricate detailing and a decorative band, alongside clothing with ornate patterns and a breastplate. The portrait is detailed in an engraving style within an oval frame inscribed with "HENRICVS VII D G ANGLIAE FRANCIAE ET HIBERNIAE REX." The background features a textured pattern.

artworks.title: King Henry VII
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving featuring a man facing slightly left with a serious expression. He has shoulder-length wavy hair under a hat with an emblem, and wears regal clothing a fur-trimmed robe with embroidered patterns. He holds a scepter and an orb with a cross. The background shows an oval frame with inscriptions "ANGLIAE GALLIAE ET HIBERNIAE REX" and "PRUDENTISS: PRIN: HENRICUS" with decorative motifs outside. Below the portrait is an inscription identifying the man as "The most Mighty ... and Prudent Prince Henry the seventh King of England," with a coat of arms and a crown.

artworks.title: Henry VII of England
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man believed to be Henry VII. He is shown in a three-quarter view of the upper body, sitting upright with a dignified posture. The man has an oval face, subtle facial features, and medium-length wavy hair under his hat. He wears a hat with a decorative front element, a fur-trimmed robe over a dark garment with intricate embroidery near the neckline. The man holds a scepter in his right hand and a royal orb in his left. The background is filled with detailed engraving, including borders, a decorative banner, heraldic symbols, and Latin inscriptions. At the bottom, there is a coat of arms and an inscription of his royal titles.

artworks.title: Henry VII of England
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of the upper torso and head of a man seated, facing forward with a slight leftward turn of his head. The man has a serious expression with distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, thin lips, and long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He wears a cap with a circular badge featuring a floral motif, and ornate clothing with fur lining, detailed embroidery, and a brooch. In his right hand, he holds a scepter, and in his left, an orb topped with a cross. The background is an oval frame with Latin text, floral motifs, and a crown. Below the portrait is a coat of arms and English text identifying the person as Henry the Seventh, King of England.

artworks.title: Henry VII of England
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his left, holding a scepter in his right hand and an orb in his left hand. The man has a stern expression with prominent facial features. He has shoulder-length wavy hair, visible under a wide-brimmed hat with an emblem. He wears a robe with fur trimmings and intricate patterns. The portrait is encompassed by an ornate oval frame with Latin inscriptions, fleur-de-lis, and lion motifs. The background features scrollwork and a coat of arms below the portrait.

artworks.title: Henry VII of England
artworks.description: This is a portrait engraving depicting the upper half of a man facing slightly to the left but looking towards the viewer. He has defined cheekbones, a long straight nose, and lips set in a composed manner. His medium-length hair is visible under a flat cap with a circular emblem. He wears an ornate garment with detailed embroidery and fur trim, suggesting royal or noble status. He has a chain or medal around his neck. In his right hand, he holds a sceptre, and in his left hand, he grasps an orb. The background is filled with intricate linework and features an elaborate oval border framing the portrait. The image includes titles, Latin script, heraldic symbols at the top corners, and a coat of arms and English text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Henry VII of England
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a seated person facing forward. The person has distinct facial features, medium-length grey hair, and wears a fur-trimmed robe with ornate embroidery. A hat with a jewel adorns their head. They hold an ornate scepter in one hand and place the other hand on top of a globus cruciger. The background features a simple texture pattern with two crowned emblems. Classical-style text is below the portrait.

artworks.title: King Henry VII
artworks.description: The image depicts a historical portrait of an elderly man seated and facing forward. The man has long, gaunt facial features with prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, a furrowed brow, and long hair covered by a flat cap with a jewel. He is wearing elaborate robes with a fur-trimmed collar and an intricate necklace, and he holds a scepter in his right hand and an orb in his left hand. In the background, there is a textured pattern. Beside the man, there is a shield and a decorative emblem, each topped by a crown.

artworks.title: Henrici VIII Angliae, Franciae et Hiberniam Rex (King Henry VIII)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up, positioned facing forward. He has a round face, a prominent jawline, and small eyes. He has a short beard and moustache, and his hair is styled with waves gently tucking under a flat hat adorned with jewels and an ornate band. He wears richly decorated clothing featuring a doublet with intricate designs and a fur-lined robe draped over his shoulders. The ensemble is embellished with ornate chains and pearls, including a chain across his chest and rings on his fingers. He holds a staff with a decorative top in his left hand. The background is an intricately patterned oval with scroll-like elements and writing surrounding the portrait, including an inscription in Latin and English detailing his titles and achievements. The upper corners show decorative shield-like emblems.

artworks.title: Henrici VIII Angliae, Franciae et Hiberniam Rex (King Henry VIII)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man facing forward. He has a rounded face with a short beard and mustache. He is wearing a decorated cap, a heavily ornamented coat with large shoulder pads, and intricate garments with pearls or gems. The man is adorned with a chain around his neck, holding a scepter in his right hand and an orb in his left. The background features engraving with Latin text and a description identifying him as King Henry VIII of England, with coats of arms above him.
